name: 公開前のストア保護状態と解除操作カード
prompt:
Refine the current candidate for this same Shopify card, using both supplied images: the original crop is the authority for exact proportions and illustration, and v001 is the base to refine. The target is 395x405 pixels (0.975:1). Keep the near-square card, the close key-and-green-store-mascot illustration, and the established visual hierarchy.

The first candidate's title and descriptive copy fit well, and its illustration is close to the source. Correct the button proportions: the source button at bottom left is about 133x43 pixels, while v001 is too wide. Use the shorter, natural Japanese label 「ストアを公開」 so the white outlined pill stays close to 133x43. Shorten the heading to 「オンラインストアを公開」. Keep the description meaning and two-line layout: 「公開準備が整うまで、ストアは」 / 「パスワードで保護されます。」.

Preserve the key and mascot from the source crop and v001: silver round key ring in the lower-right half, key extending diagonally down-left, green rectangular smiling store-bag character with white-gloved hands and green-and-white shoes. Keep its source pose, colors, outline, highlights, and approximate placement. Do not replace it with a lock icon or redraw it into another character.

Match the reference card's 395x405 proportions: title begins around x34/y33; description around x34/y66; key ring around x275/y150; key tip around x162/y305; mascot occupies the lower-right area; button around x33/y354 with about 133x43 size. Keep small system sans-serif type, thin light-gray border, white background, generous blank center, rounded corners, and only this one card. No extra text, neighboring cards, or other actions.
reviewNotes: v002 preserves the source card proportions and key-and-mascot illustration, and the shorter 「ストアを公開」 button now matches the source button width. The button remains about 12-16 px too high within the 405 px card, leaving too much bottom padding; recorded needs-correction at the two-attempt limit.
